text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu cancels visit to Amman today.
- Jordanian prisoners were hurt in clashes in Kuwaiti prisons but were not targeted, official says.
- Third day of rains replenishes water supplies.
- Record rise in Bank of Jordan's 1996 profits.
- Sources say King Hussein to travel to Britain, Germany and Morocco over Eid holiday.
- Algeria's Sonatrach signs agreement for evaluation of exploration potential in Jordan's southern Sarhan region.
- Parliament approves cancellation of 15 percent tax on capital increase.
- Sudan envoy thanks Jordan for its support in conflict with rebels.
- Prime Minister Kabariti pledges to carry out King Hussein's directive on maintenance of Moslem holy sites in Jerusalem.
